svg.title: Full system pipeline — stage flow
svg.desc: Three-stage pipeline showing data flow from raw inputs through inference, post-processing, and model training

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the video filename timestamp encode?')
sendPrompt('What YOLO models are used?')
sendPrompt('What is cow_registry used for?')
sendPrompt('How does ByteTrack assign temp_ids?')
sendPrompt('What are the 19 pose keypoints?')
sendPrompt('Why save embeddings at inference time?')
sendPrompt('What columns does raw_tracks contain?')
g.text: session_id · frame_datetime · temp_id · bbox · det_conf · embed[128] · kps[19×3] · kps_kconf[19]

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is stored in video_sessions?')
sendPrompt('What is the structure of collar_signals?')
sendPrompt('How does the kinetic matcher work?')
g.text: bbox speed ↔ ΔR · Pearson r · Hungarian

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What vision features are derived from keypoints?')
sendPrompt('How does the gallery builder update embeddings?')
g.text: group embeds by AnimalId → EMA mean

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does cosine resolution heal temp_id switches?')
g.text: embed vs gallery.npz → real_id or null

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is stored in reid_registry?')
sendPrompt('How are sensor features aligned to video time?')
sendPrompt('What is the structure of resolved_cow_timeline?')
g.text: sensor: Δf_12 Δf_23 Δv Δkin_X/Y/Z/R | vision: spine_angle pelvic_tilt tail_elev lying_flag restlessness embed_mean[128] kps_coverage

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the calving_ledger contain?')
sendPrompt('What static features come from cow_registry?')
sendPrompt('How are training windows constructed?')
g.text: multi-hour window per calving event · label attach · modality-mask filter · stratified split

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What temporal model architecture is used?')
g.text: fused feature sequence → 4-class softmax · class-weighted loss for rare events

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What are the four calving outcome classes?')
g.text: Unassisted · Assisted · Twin · Veterinarian-assisted + risk score + prediction horizon
